raised: Two different dates in the intro paragraph (2025 fees vs Sept 2026 data) made them stop and reread
The '123 מקור / 123 מחושב' legend was confusing
Counts don't match: button says 105, text says 96 tracks in 7 products, and there are 10 buttons
The main table is very long and tiring
The explanation of 'אין' is only in a footnote; they wanted it at the top
Codes PF-06 and PF-10 mean nothing
Direct expenses are not included, so the fee shown isn't the full cost
Fund tags and fee terms (צוברת, חשיפה לדולר, קבועים/משתנים/נאמן) are jargon
The documents section is all collapsed, so it's unclear what's inside
'פחות מ־3 שנים' on many rows leaves nothing to compare
The same S&P 500 track shows different returns in different products, with no explanation
The purpose of the 'קופה' number column and its icon is unclear
The small ring charts mean nothing
The dotted underlines on numbers don't look clickable and their purpose is unclear
The differences between product types (קופת גמל להשקעה, תגמולים, מרכזית לפיצויים) are not explained
The difference between קרן חדשה מקיפה and קרן חדשה כללית is not explained
It's unclear whether foreign-currency (מט"ח) exposure is good or bad
Unclear whether 'עוד לא דווח' means zero or unknown
No guidance on how to find which product and track is theirs
No fee shown in shekels
No comparison with other companies
No information on whether fees can be negotiated
No returns shown after fees and tax
No guidance on suitable risk by age
Would drop the 'חיסכון לכל ילד' section as irrelevant

problems.why: The report mentions the sorting arrows in the headers only to say it ignored them, and never mentions a '?' mark in a column head wrapping onto its own line.
